shortDefinition.en: Blur caused by camera movement during exposure, distinct from subject movement or missed focus.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 曝光期间相机移动造成的模糊，与主体运动或对焦错误不同。

en: Image stabilization does not freeze a moving subject.
zh-cn: 图像防抖不能凝固运动主体。

example.en: A stationary background can show directional smear while the subject is also affected by the camera's motion.
example.zh-cn: 相机运动可能让静止背景出现方向性涂抹，主体也会受到影响。

sources.title: Camera Shutter Speed — Cambridge in Colour
sources.supports: Camera-shake visibility is distinct from subject motion.
